name: The Tower of Althalaxx
summary: At the Tower of Althalaxx, Dark Strand cultists are gathering, and Balthule Shadowstrike needs help. He sends an Alliance courier to Maestra's Post in Ashenvale with a warning for his mentor, Delgren the Purifier.

sections.title: A Plea for Reinforcements
sections.body: Balthule Shadowstrike sees that the Dark Strand threat is too great for one scout to face alone. After clashing with cultists near the Tower of Althalaxx, he writes a report and entrusts it to an Alliance messenger bound for his master, Delgren the Purifier. The cult's summoners are growing bolder, and Balthule needs seasoned leaders to direct a response.

sections.title: The Road to Ashenvale
sections.body: Balthule's dispatch takes you south along Darkshore's coastal road, then across the wooded border into Ashenvale. Delgren the Purifier is stationed at Maestra's Post, beside the western road. The human paladin works to cleanse demons and undead from the woodland. Though night elven customs were once unfamiliar to him, he has earned the Sentinels' deep respect as an indispensable ally.

sections.title: A Holy Warrior Awakened
sections.body: Delgren the Purifier receives Balthule's urgent letter and reads it with grim resolve. Devoted to the Holy Light, he sees dark cultists, corrupted souls, and demonic fiends in the ancient woods as an intolerable blight. The letter reports the Dark Strand's entrenched foothold in the ruined highborne tower, and Delgren prepares to take charge and strike back.

faq.answer: Delgren the Purifier is a human paladin stationed at Maestra's Post in Ashenvale. Devoted to the Holy Light, he brings martial and spiritual expertise to the night elf Sentinels' fight against demons and undead in their ancestral forests.

faq.q: Why is Balthule Shadowstrike sending a messenger to Ashenvale?
faq.answer: Balthule Shadowstrike is a scout outside the Tower of Althalaxx, where he studies the Dark Strand cult. As its dark rituals and numbers grow, he sends his findings to his mentor Delgren so they can organize a strike.

faq.q: What is the relationship between Balthule and Delgren?
aliases: how do balthule and delgren know each other
faq.answer: Delgren is Balthule's master. The human paladin taught the night elf the art of battle and the teachings of the Holy Light, forging a close bond across their cultural divides.
Maestra's Post is an Alliance outpost in western Ashenvale, beside the main road south from Darkshore. Travelers pass it on the way into the forest.

faq.q: What is the Dark Strand cult doing at the Tower of Althalaxx?
faq.answer: The Dark Strand cult operates from the ruined highborne Tower of Althalaxx in northern Darkshore. Its members practice dark arts, consort with demonic powers, and threaten to spread corruption along the shoreline.

faq.q: How does Delgren view his alliance with the night elves?
faq.answer: Delgren first found night elven manners and ways unfamiliar after arriving in Kalimdor. Fighting common evils beside them has earned the Sentinels his deep respect.

angles.text: As a paladin, you can see Delgren as an example of your holy calling in unfamiliar lands. The human crusader wields the Light and has earned the trust of Kalimdor's reclusive night elves.
As a night elf, you can see your Sentinels building a practical partnership with eastern allies who have come to purge demonic remnants from your woods.
As an Alliance member, you can see how Balthule in Darkshore and Delgren in Ashenvale keep the scattered Alliance garrisons of northern Kalimdor in contact.
